## Context

`docs/code-brain-design.md` (this repo) records the design decided in a long
session on 2026-07-24. It splits into:

- **R1 / R2 / R3** — memory kinds + reach, bi-temporal facts, authority tiers.
  Stated as **requirements**, not options.
- **R4** — file citation in answers. Closed-brain only: leave hooks, build nothing.

The headline finding it exists to fix: **Open Brain does not have a design
problem, it has a wiring problem.** Eight measured instances of one defect —
capability built, tested, correct, and nothing calls it. One of the eight
(PreCompact capture) was fixed the same session and has since fired in
production.
